name: sentry_get_dev_context
description: Master entry point. Use when asked "what am I working on?", "what's the status?", "show me the context", or before any triage task. Returns: configured instance + org, your Sentry identity, unresolved issues assigned to you, and recent unresolved issues across the org with actionable next-step hints.

name: sentry_search
description:
Discover Sentry resources. Use when asked "list projects", "show issues for X", "what teams exist", or "find user alice". Set resource:
• "issues" (default) — list issues; pass projectSlug for one project, or omit it to search the whole organization. Filter with query and/or status
• "projects" — list all projects in the organization
• "teams" — list all teams in the organization
• "users" — find members by name/email (pass query). Useful for confirming who exists; `sentry_mutate_issue assignedTo` resolves emails and names on its own.

projectSlug.description: Project slug, e.g. "my-web-app". Optional for resource=issues — omit it to search every project in the organization.

query.description: Sentry issue search query, or a name/email filter for users. Issue examples: "is:unresolved", "assigned:me", "environment:production", "timesSeen:>100", "firstSeen:-24h", "release:1.2.3".

status.description: Status filter, appended to query (issues only)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

name: sentry_get_issue
description: Full details for one Sentry issue by ID or URL. Returns a compact projection of the issue's metadata; pass includeLatestEvent=true to also pull a trimmed version of the most recent event. The response's `_full` field is the endpoint that returns everything, for use with `sentry_raw_api path=...`. Use includeFields, excludeFields, grepPattern and maxStackFrames to slim it further.

issueIdOrUrl.description: Issue reference: numeric ID ("60741"), short ID as printed by sentry_get_dev_context and returned on every issue row ("PROJECT-ABC"), or a full issue URL.

includeFields.description: Whitelist of fields to keep. Dot notation supported (e.g. "latest_event.entries").

excludeFields.description: Blacklist of fields to drop. Applied only when includeFields is unset.

grepPattern.description: Regex filtering the rendered response — the TOON or JSON text you would otherwise receive, not the raw Sentry JSON. Returns matching lines plus one line of context either side, and always the table header. Case-insensitive.

maxStackFrames.description: Trim stack traces to the last N frames (the most relevant ones).

name: sentry_get_event
description: Full details for a specific event in a project. Sentry events can be very large — by default returns at most 5 entries, prioritising exception → message → breadcrumbs → request, each projected down to what a reader acts on. `entries_info.available_types` lists every entry the event has; pass entryType to filter to one kind, or limit/offset to page. The `_full` field is the endpoint that returns the whole event. Pass issueIdOrUrl on its own to read that issue's latest event — no project slug needed.

issueIdOrUrl.description: Issue reference: numeric ID ("60741"), short ID as printed by sentry_get_dev_context and returned on every issue row ("PROJECT-ABC"), or a full issue URL.

eventId.description: Event ID, or "latest" (the default when omitted) for the most recent event.

entryType.description: Return only entries of this type

name: sentry_mutate_issue
description: Update status, change assignee, and/or add a comment on a Sentry issue in one call. Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks to "resolve issue 123", "ignore this issue", "assign 123 to alice", or "add a comment on 123". Do NOT pre-emptively resolve or reassign issues during exploration. assignedTo accepts a username, email, real name, or "team:slug" and is resolved server-side; an assignment that does not stick is reported as an error rather than a success.

issueId.description: Issue reference: numeric ID ("60741"), short ID as printed by sentry_get_dev_context and returned on every issue row ("PROJECT-ABC"), or a full issue URL.

assignedTo.description: Who to assign to: a username, an email, a real name, or "team:slug". Emails and names are resolved to a username server-side, and an ambiguous match comes back as an error listing the candidates. Pass an empty string to unassign.

comment.description: Comment to add after other mutations (optional)

name: sentry_comment
description: Add, update, or delete a comment on a Sentry issue. action defaults to "add". Can only edit/delete your own comments.

issueId.description: Issue reference: numeric ID ("60741"), short ID as printed by sentry_get_dev_context and returned on every issue row ("PROJECT-ABC"), or a full issue URL.

name: sentry_stack_frames
description: Extract structured stack-trace frames from an event. Optimised for debugging — a flat table of function/file/line/inApp with none of the surrounding event noise, plus `source`: the source-code window for the deepest in-app frame. Columns this platform never populates (module, package, addresses) are dropped from the response. Much more compact than sentry_get_event for stack analysis. Pass issueIdOrUrl on its own to read the latest event's trace for that issue — no project slug needed.

issueIdOrUrl.description: Issue reference: numeric ID ("60741"), short ID as printed by sentry_get_dev_context and returned on every issue row ("PROJECT-ABC"), or a full issue URL.

eventId.description: Event ID, or "latest" (the default when omitted) for the most recent event.

maxFrames.description: Max frames, keeping the most recent / bottom of stack (default 50)

name: sentry_check_dsym
description: Check whether iOS / macOS / Android debug symbols (dSYM, ProGuard mapping) are missing for an event. Missing symbols cause stack traces to show addresses instead of function names. Returns the UUIDs to upload. Pass issueIdOrUrl on its own to check that issue's latest event — no project slug needed.

issueIdOrUrl.description: Issue reference: numeric ID ("60741"), short ID as printed by sentry_get_dev_context and returned on every issue row ("PROJECT-ABC"), or a full issue URL.

eventId.description: Event ID, or "latest" (the default when omitted) for the most recent event.

name: sentry_raw_api
description: Make a raw call to any Sentry API endpoint. Use when the structured tools above don't cover what you need, and to pull detail a compact response left out: pass the `_full` endpoint from any response together with path=<dotted.path> to fetch just that subtree. Endpoint should be the path after /api/0/ (e.g. "organizations/my-org/releases/"). A response over ~20k tokens comes back as a shape sketch instead of its contents — narrow it with path, grepPattern, or maxChars/charOffset.

endpoint.description: API path, e.g. "projects/my-org/my-project/events/abc123/". Leading /api/0/ is stripped if present. The `_full` field of a compact response holds exactly this value for that response's complete payload.

path.description: Dot-separated path into the response, applied before any other filter. Numeric segments index arrays, e.g. "entries.0.data.values.0.stacktrace.frames". A wrong path reports the keys that were actually available.

outline.description: Return the shape of the response (keys, array lengths, leaf types) instead of its contents. Combine with path to sketch one subtree before pulling it.

grepPattern.description: Regex filtering the rendered response — the TOON or JSON text you would otherwise receive, not the raw Sentry JSON. Returns matching lines plus one line of context either side, and always the table header. Case-insensitive.

maxChars.description: Max characters of JSON response to return. Pair with charOffset to page through large responses.

charOffset.description: Skip this many characters from the start of the response (for paging).
